subject: release-tooling/auto-periodic-update
statement: Automatic updates follow only the unique reachable fromVersion-toVersion chain from the current project VERSION. Forks and cycles fail closed. Periodic mode is a foreground interval loop over the same auto operation, not a daemon or service. An unchanged failed catalog is suppressed until scenario content or VERSION changes unless retry is explicitly requested.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Preserve reusable R7 declarative-update, recovery, and automatic-update lessons after successful 0.16.2 dogfood.
